name: homePos
meaning: Ground-snapped Init pos, or pos at msg 9 arg 1; Reset restores it.

name: jailDist
meaning: 3-axis Manhattan distance to the jail, computed by Key_Update; 410 when |dvert| >= 200. Use needs < 400. Stale while the key is not updated (stowed).

name: jail
meaning: Jail (class 0x7e) from FindByClass; receives msg 0x4300. Its +0xb4 (non-zero = already opened, inferred) disables HELD_KEY_USE.
